physicalNotes: No radius or mass of the Pleiades is recorded: it is an extended star cluster, and its package frames it at 11.1 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), Hunt & Reffert's tidal radius estimate, a presentation value.

sources.position: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), Melotte_22: RA_ICRS 56.67978318, DE_ICRS 24.10845447, the densest point of its members (epoch 2016.0) (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/A+A/673/A114)
sources.distance: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), Melotte_22: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 134.84134308 pc (16th to 84th percentile 134.82 to 134.86) (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/A+A/673/A114)
sources.properMotion: Zero: the cluster is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Table 3, Melotte_22: mean Gaia DR3 radial velocity 5.34254864 km/s of 398 members (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/A+A/673/A114)
